story-context.acceptanceCriteria:
### AC-1: POST /api/users/{user_id}/roles - Assign Role Endpoint - Endpoint: POST /api/v1/users/{user_id}/roles - Request body: {tenant_id: UUID, role: RoleEnum} - Auth: super_admin or tenant_admin (own tenant only) - Returns: 201 Created with RoleAssignmentResponse - Validation: user exists, tenant exists, valid role, no duplicates - Side effects: Creates UserTenantRole, audit log, invalidates JWT
### AC-2: DELETE /api/users/{user_id}/roles/{role_id} - Revoke Role Endpoint - Endpoint: DELETE /api/v1/users/{user_id}/roles/{role_id} - Auth: super_admin or tenant_admin (own tenant only) - Returns: 204 No Content - Protection: Cannot remove last super_admin role - Side effects: Deletes UserTenantRole, audit log, invalidates JWT
### AC-3: GET /api/users/{user_id}/roles - List User's Roles - Endpoint: GET /api/v1/users/{user_id}/roles - Auth: super_admin (all), tenant_admin (own tenant), user (self only) - Returns: Array of RoleAssignmentResponse with tenant_name joined - RBAC enforced by current user's role
### AC-4: GET /api/roles - List Available Roles - Endpoint: GET /api/v1/roles - Auth: Any authenticated user - Returns: Array of {role, display_name, description, level} ordered by level - Static list of 5 roles (super_admin, tenant_admin, developer, operator, viewer)
### AC-5: Authorization & Tenant Scoping - tenant_admin can only assign/revoke roles for own tenant (default_tenant_id match) - super_admin can manage roles for any tenant - Use @require_role("super_admin", "tenant_admin") decorator - Return 403 Forbidden for tenant boundary violations
### AC-6: Last Super Admin Protection - Before revoking role, check COUNT(*) WHERE role = 'super_admin' - If count = 1 and attempting to delete, return 400 Bad Request - Error message: "Cannot remove the last super_admin role from the system"
### AC-7: Audit Logging for All Operations - Log action="role_assigned" with user_id, tenant_id, role, assigned_by, IP, timestamp - Log action="role_revoked" with same metadata fields - Use existing AuditLog model, log after successful operation in service layer
### AC-8: Input Validation with Pydantic Schemas - RoleAssignmentCreate schema: tenant_id (UUID), role (RoleEnum with validator) - RoleAssignmentResponse schema: id, user_id, tenant_id, tenant_name, role, assigned_at, assigned_by - RoleInfo schema: role, display_name, description, level - Pydantic validation errors returned as 422 Unprocessable Entity

artifact.reason: Core model for role assignments. Has unique constraint on (user_id, tenant_id, role) preventing duplicates. Includes assigned_by foreign key for audit trail.
Enum definition for 5 roles: SUPER_ADMIN, TENANT_ADMIN, DEVELOPER, OPERATOR, VIEWER. Used for validation in Pydantic schemas.
User model with email, password_hash, default_tenant_id, is_active, force_password_change, last_login_at. Target of role assignments.
Audit logging model for tracking all operations. Includes action, user_id, tenant_id, details JSON, request_ip, timestamp fields.
Existing FastAPI router with user CRUD endpoints. Demonstrates @require_role decorator usage, Depends(get_current_user) pattern, and tenant scoping logic.
Shows initial_role assignment pattern. Creates User and UserTenantRole in same transaction. Example of validation, error handling, audit logging.
RBAC decorator factory. Returns decorator that checks current_user.role against allowed_roles list. Raises 403 HTTPException if unauthorized.
Extracts and validates JWT token, returns User object. Used with Depends() for endpoint auth. Checks token validity and user is_active status.
Example Pydantic schema for user responses. Shows field validation, model_config, and response serialization patterns to follow.
Service layer pattern for user management. Shows async database operations, validation logic, error handling, and audit logging integration. Model for new role_service.py.

story-context.constraints: - **C1: RBAC Pattern** - Use @require_role("super_admin", "tenant_admin") decorator on all endpoints. Extract current user via Depends(get_current_user). - **C2: Tenant Isolation** - tenant_admin can ONLY manage roles for their default_tenant_id. super_admin has no restrictions. Enforce at service layer. - **C3: Service Layer Pattern** - Business logic belongs in src/services/role_service.py, NOT in endpoints. Endpoints call service functions. - **C4: Audit Logging** - ALL operations must log to AuditLog table after successful completion. Include user_id, tenant_id, role, assigned_by/revoked_by, IP, timestamp. - **C5: Last Super Admin Protection** - MUST prevent deletion of last super_admin role. Query COUNT(*) before deletion, return 400 if count would be 0. - **C6: Validation Order** - Validate in this order: (1) Authentication (JWT valid), (2) Authorization (has required role), (3) Input (Pydantic), (4) Business rules (tenant scope, duplicate check, last admin). - **C7: Error Handling** - Return appropriate HTTP status codes: 400 (validation), 401 (auth), 403 (authorization), 404 (not found), 422 (Pydantic validation). - **C8: Database Transactions** - Use async database sessions. Commit after successful operation, rollback on error. No partial commits. - **C9: Unique Constraint** - UserTenantRole has unique constraint on (user_id, tenant_id, role). Catch IntegrityError and return 400 "duplicate assignment". - **C10: JWT Invalidation** - After role changes, user's JWT token contains outdated role information. Document that user must re-login to see new permissions (optional: implement token revocation). - **C11: OpenAPI Documentation** - Add detailed descriptions, request/response examples, and tags to all endpoints for auto-generated docs at /docs. - **C12: Testing Coverage** - Minimum 80% coverage for service layer and endpoints. Test all validation rules, RBAC scenarios, and edge cases.

interface.name: assign_role
interface.signature:
async def assign_role( db: AsyncSession, user_id: UUID, tenant_id: UUID, role: RoleEnum, assigned_by: UUID ) -> UserTenantRole: """ Assign a role to a user for a specific tenant.
Validates: user exists, tenant exists, no duplicate assignment Side effects: Creates UserTenantRole, logs to audit Raises: ValueError for validation failures """

interface.name: revoke_role
interface.signature:
async def revoke_role( db: AsyncSession, role_id: UUID, revoked_by: UUID ) -> None: """ Revoke a role assignment.
Validates: role exists, not last super_admin Side effects: Deletes UserTenantRole, logs to audit Raises: ValueError for validation failures (last super_admin) """

tests.standards:
**Testing Framework:** Pytest with pytest-asyncio for async support
**Unit Tests:** Test service layer functions in isolation with mocked database sessions. Focus on business logic validation (tenant scoping, duplicate checks, last super_admin protection).
**Integration Tests:** Use FastAPI TestClient with test database. Test full request/response cycle, authentication, authorization, and database state changes.
**Fixtures:** Reuse existing fixtures from tests/fixtures/ for database sessions, test users, test tenants, and authentication tokens.
**Coverage Target:** Minimum 80% for service layer and endpoint functions. Use pytest-cov to measure.
**Naming Convention:** test_{function_name}_{scenario} (e.g., test_assign_role_duplicate_raises_error)
**Assertions:** Verify status codes, response schemas, database state, and audit log entries.
tests.locations: - tests/unit/test_role_service.py - Service layer unit tests - tests/integration/test_roles_api.py - Endpoint integration tests
tests.ideas:

**Unit Tests for AC-2 (Revoke Role):** - test_revoke_role_success - Happy path deletion - test_revoke_role_last_super_admin_raises_error - Protection against removing last super_admin - test_revoke_role_not_found_raises_error - Role assignment doesn't exist
**Unit Tests for AC-3 (List User Roles):** - test_get_user_roles_with_super_admin - super_admin sees all roles - test_get_user_roles_with_tenant_admin - Tenant-scoped filtering - test_get_user_roles_with_regular_user - User can only see own roles
**Integration Tests for AC-1:** - test_assign_role_as_super_admin_success - 201 Created response - test_assign_role_as_tenant_admin_own_tenant - 201 Created - test_assign_role_as_tenant_admin_other_tenant - 403 Forbidden - test_assign_role_duplicate_returns_400 - Validation error - test_assign_role_without_auth_returns_401 - Unauthorized
**Integration Tests for AC-2:** - test_revoke_role_success_returns_204 - Successful deletion - test_revoke_role_last_super_admin_returns_400 - Protection enforced - test_revoke_role_as_tenant_admin_other_tenant - 403 Forbidden
**Integration Tests for AC-3:** - test_list_user_roles_as_super_admin - Returns all roles - test_list_user_roles_as_regular_user_viewing_self - Success - test_list_user_roles_as_regular_user_viewing_others - 403 Forbidden
**Integration Tests for AC-4:** - test_list_available_roles_returns_5_roles - Response validation
**Integration Tests for AC-7 (Audit Logging):** - test_assign_role_creates_audit_log - Verify AuditLog entry with correct metadata - test_revoke_role_creates_audit_log - Verify audit trail
